summary: This sermon explores Jesus washing his disciples' feet in John 13 as a model for sacrificial service done in hiddenness. The preacher argues that genuine kingdom service flows from deeply knowing God's love for us, not from guilt or a desire for recognition, and calls the congregation to start by serving friends privately before attempting more public acts.
key_points: Jesus washed feet while disciples debated greatness, modeling true kingdom service
We often serve with mixed motivations—guilt, recognition, or self-interest
We must experientially understand Christ's love before serving others properly
Hidden acts of service form us into people who can serve publicly
Start small: serve someone close to you in private this week
big_idea: Genuine kingdom service flows from an experiential understanding of how deeply Christ loves us, enabling us to serve others out of abundance rather than scarcity, guilt, or the desire for recognition.
title: PTW Service: HIDDENNESS
